name: grep
description: Search text files in the workspace for a word or phrase and return matching lines with file paths and line numbers. Stops after max_matches and says if there were more. Skips binary files, files over 1 MB, secret files, and folders like .git, .venv and node_modules. Use path or glob to narrow the search.

pattern.description: Text to find (or a regular expression when regex is true)

path.description: Folder or file to search, relative to the workspace. Default "."

glob.description: Only files whose name matches, e.g. "*.py"

regex.description: Treat pattern as a regular expression. Default false

max_matches.description: Stop after this many matching lines. Default 50, max 500
